ideas.children_he: בְּחִירַת אַהֲרֹן וּבִגְדֵי הַקּוֹדֶשׁ — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Moses is commanded to appoint Aaron and his sons as priests and prepare sacred garments for honor and glory with the help of skilled artisans. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: חוֹמְרֵי הָאֵפוֹד וּמִבְנֵהוּ — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The artisans use gold, blue, purple, scarlet yarn, and fine linen to make the ephod, its shoulder pieces, and its woven waistband. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: אַבְנֵי הַזִּיכָּרוֹן עַל כְּתֵפֵי הָאֵפוֹד — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The names of the Israelites are engraved on two onyx stones, set in gold and placed on the ephod’s shoulders as a memorial before God. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: חוֹשֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּט וַאֲבָנָיו — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: A square doubled breastplate is made and set with four rows of precious stones, each bearing the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: חִיבּוּר הַחוֹשֶׁן אֶל הָאֵפוֹד — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Gold chains, rings, and blue cords firmly attach the breastplate to the ephod so it will not shift during wear. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: אַהֲרֹן נוֹשֵׂא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל לִבּוֹ — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: When entering the sanctuary, Aaron bears the names of the Israelites over his heart as a continual remembrance before God. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: הָאוֹרִים וְהַתּוּמִים וּמִשְׁפַּט יִשְׂרָאֵל — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The Urim and Thummim are placed inside the breastplate, and Aaron continually bears the judgment of the Israelites before God. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: מְעִיל הָאֵפוֹד הַתְּכֵלֶת — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The ephod robe is made entirely of blue wool, with a woven reinforced neck opening that will not tear. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: רִימּוֹנִים וּפַעֲמוֹנִים בְּשׁוּלֵי הַמְּעִיל — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Colored pomegranates and golden bells are attached alternately around the robe’s hem, so Aaron’s sound is heard as he enters and leaves the sanctuary. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: צִיץ הַזָּהָב עַל מֵצַח אַהֲרֹן — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: A plate of pure gold bearing a sacred engraving is fastened to Aaron’s turban and rests on his forehead continually for acceptance before the Lord. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: בִּגְדֵי אַהֲרֹן וּבִנָיוּ — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Tunics, turbans, sashes, and caps are prepared for Aaron and his sons; they are dressed, anointed, and consecrated for priestly service. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: מִכְנְסֵי הַבַּד לְכִיסּוּי — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The priests receive linen undergarments for proper covering when entering the tent of meeting or approaching the altar, as an enduring statute. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.
